options: I commute to work by train every morning.
I commute at the gym after work.
I commute my emails during lunch.
questions.answer: I commute to work by train every morning.
questions.explanation: “To commute” means to travel regularly between home and work or school.

questions.prompt: You need to go to the bank, buy groceries, and pick up a package. What are you doing?
questions.explanation: “To run errands” means to make short trips to complete practical tasks.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word to complete the sentence: “I thought the store was closed, but it was _____ open.”
questions.explanation: “Actually” is used to show that the real situation is different from what someone thought.

questions.prompt: I usually wake up at 6:30, but I do not _____ until 6:45.
questions.explanation: “Get up” means to leave your bed after waking up.

questions.prompt: She goes to the gym three times a week to _____.
questions.explanation: “To work out” means to exercise, especially to improve fitness.

questions.prompt: My schedule is very busy, but I can _____ a quick lunch with you at noon.
questions.explanation: “To squeeze in” means to find time for something despite a busy schedule.

questions.prompt: Traduza para o inglês: “Eu geralmente vou para a cama às onze.”
questions.answer: I usually go to bed at eleven.|I usually go to bed at 11.
questions.explanation: “Go to bed” means to go to your bed because you are ready to sleep.

questions.prompt: Traduza para o inglês: “Meu despertador toca às seis da manhã.”
questions.answer: My alarm goes off at six in the morning.|My alarm goes off at 6 a.m.
questions.explanation: “My alarm goes off” means that the alarm starts ringing or making a sound.

questions.prompt: Traduza para o inglês: “Depois de várias tentativas, eu finalmente consegui.”
questions.answer: After several attempts, I eventually succeeded.|After several tries, I eventually managed to do it.|Eventually, I succeeded after several attempts.
questions.explanation: “Eventually” means in the end, especially after a delay or several attempts.
